title: MetricQ HTA database (S3)
description: State of one metricq-db-hta-s3 database, selected by its MetricQ token.

panels.title: Version
panels.description: Build version of the database.

panels.title: Metrics
panels.description: Metrics configured by the MetricQ manager.

panels.title: Backpressure
panels.description: 1 while the WAL high watermark or ingest memory limit refuses deliveries. See Operations → Tuning.

panels.title: Last checkpoint
panels.description: Seconds since the last published checkpoint (manifest).

panels.title: Compaction job pending
panels.description: 1 while a reserved or aborted job is recorded; an aborted job blocks compaction for about a minute.

panels.title: Samples
panels.description: Accepted and dropped (duplicate, out-of-order, non-finite) samples per second.

panels.title: Deliveries per fsync
panels.description: Group commit: AMQP deliveries made durable by one WAL fsync. Bounded by prefetch.

panels.title: WAL size
panels.description: Local WAL bytes not yet covered by a checkpoint, with the limits that act on it.

panels.title: WAL segments and pending frames
panels.description: More than a few segments means checkpoints fail or cannot keep up.

panels.title: Backpressure events
panels.description: Ingest attempts refused by WAL high watermark or ingest memory limit; each triggers an inline checkpoint.

panels.title: Checkpoints by trigger
panels.description: wal/object_target: size thresholds; hold_age/hold_budget: holding; explicit: backpressure or shutdown.

panels.title: Blocks written
panels.description: Partial blocks (below 1024 records) become compaction work. Holding keeps this low.

panels.title: Unsaved bytes
panels.description: Records only in the WAL. A checkpoint starts at the object target.

panels.title: Held memory
panels.description: Above the hold budget the largest streams are written early (partial blocks).

panels.title: Manifest size
panels.description: Written with every checkpoint and maintenance publication.

panels.title: Stored bytes
panels.description: Dead bytes are unreferenced parts of partly live objects; compaction reclaims them above compaction_reclaim_dead_fraction.

panels.title: Fragmentation
panels.description: Fragments are small blocks inside a stream and should return towards zero; a steady rise means compaction falls behind. Open tails are the newest partial block of each stream and only fill with new records.

panels.title: Blocks in and out
panels.description: Input minus output is the rate at which fragments are merged away.

panels.title: Level locality
panels.description: Jobs laying out consecutive blocks of a metric level contiguously (fewer GETs per FLEX query).

panels.title: Pinned index entries
panels.description: Rightmost index paths kept for checkpoints (bounded).
